title: Winter sun from Stansted in February: direct flights compared
author: Brogan
intro: Stansted has more cheap winter sun flights than almost any UK airport, thanks to Ryanair, Jet2 and TUI. Here's where you can fly direct in February, how long it takes and how warm each place usually is, so you can pick the right trip for half term or a week away.
seo_title: Winter sun from Stansted in February: 2½ to 7 hrs away
seo_description: The Canaries are about 4½ hours from Stansted and 20-22°C in February. Egypt and Dubai are warmer but further. Every direct option compared.

sections.heading: The short answer
sections.text:
- **Warm and close:** the Canaries, 4½ hrs
- **New this winter:** Jet2 to La Palma and Egypt
- **Warmest:** Dubai, about 25°C
- **Half term:** 15 to 19 February 2027

The temperatures are average February daytime highs from the climate figures in our guides. Flight times are typical direct times from Stansted. We checked routes in November 2026, but airlines change timetables and days often, so check the airline's own schedule for your dates before you book.

Morocco is normally an hour ahead of the UK, but it moves its clocks back for Ramadan, which is expected to start in early February 2027. So for most of February it's likely to be on UK time.

sections.heading: The Canaries: the easy choice
sections.text:
Ryanair, Jet2 and TUI all fly from Stansted to the Canary Islands, which are the warmest beach weather in Europe in February, at about 20 to 22°C by day. They're on UK time, so there's no jet lag even on a short break.

- **[Tenerife](/destinations/tenerife):** the most choice of resorts and things to do. Stay in the south for the most sunshine.
- **[Lanzarote](/destinations/lanzarote):** calmer, with volcanic scenery and low white villages.
- **[La Palma](/destinations/la-palma):** new with Jet2 from Stansted this winter. It's the greenest and quietest of the main islands, with dark skies and big volcanic walks, but fewer beaches.

February is carnival month too, with Santa Cruz de Tenerife holding one of the biggest in Europe. Our [Lanzarote or Fuerteventura](/blog/lanzarote-or-fuerteventura) and [Gran Canaria or Tenerife](/blog/gran-canaria-or-tenerife) posts help you choose an island, and [is Tenerife warm in February?](/blog/is-tenerife-warm-in-february) goes into the weather.

sections.heading: Shorter flights: Spain, Portugal, Malta and Morocco
sections.text:
Ryanair's huge Stansted network means plenty of short, cheap routes for a long weekend in the sun:

- **[Málaga](/destinations/malaga) and [Seville](/destinations/seville):** about 18°C, sunny and good for city sightseeing or lunch outside. Our [Seville or Málaga in winter](/blog/seville-or-malaga-in-winter) post compares them.
- **The [Algarve](/destinations/algarve):** about 17°C, with quiet beaches, golf and clifftop walks.
- **[Malta](/destinations/malta):** about 16°C, more of a history and food trip than a beach one in February.
- **[Marrakech](/destinations/marrakech):** about 20°C by day, but cold at night. Ryanair has flown there from Stansted for years, and to Agadir on Morocco's beach coast too.

Watch out: these places are mild rather than hot in February. Pack a jumper for the evenings, and don't count on swimming in the sea.

sections.heading: The Red Sea and Dubai: guaranteed warmth
sections.text:
If you want to be sure of real warmth, go further:

- **[Sharm el-Sheikh](/destinations/sharm-el-sheikh) and [Hurghada](/destinations/hurghada):** about 22 to 23°C with sunshine almost every day and coral reefs just offshore. Jet2 has added both from Stansted for winter 2026/27. Egypt is two hours ahead, and UK visitors need a visa, which can usually be bought on arrival.
- **[Dubai](/destinations/dubai):** about 25°C, with Emirates flying from Stansted around twice a day. It's about seven hours, and Dubai is four hours ahead in winter.

Check GOV.UK's travel advice for each country before you book, as entry rules can change.

sections.heading: February half term from Stansted
sections.text:
Essex and Hertfordshire council schools both have February half term from 15 to 19 February 2027, and most London boroughs use the same week. Academies and free schools can set their own dates, so check with your school.

- **For the best prices:** go in the first two weeks of February or after half term.
- **For a short break:** Málaga, Seville or Marrakech work well for three or four nights.
- **For a week of guaranteed warmth:** the Red Sea or Dubai.
- **For snow instead:** Jet2 flies from Stansted to Innsbruck every Saturday in the ski season.

Tip: half term Saturday is one of Stansted's busiest days. See [how early to arrive at Stansted](/blog/how-early-should-you-arrive-at-stansted-airport), and book parking or the Stansted Express ahead.

Our [February half term](/destinations/february-half-term-holidays) page has more ideas, and [where to go in February](/destinations/where-to-go-in-february) covers the whole month.

sections.heading: Where could you go from Stansted?
sections.text:
Start with [Tenerife](/destinations/tenerife) for an easy week, [La Palma](/destinations/la-palma) for something quieter, or [Sharm el-Sheikh](/destinations/sharm-el-sheikh) for proper warmth. Our guide to [where you can fly direct from Stansted](/blog/where-can-you-fly-direct-from-stansted-airport) has the full route map, including city breaks and Lapland.

Can't agree? Add your favourites to somewhere.party, give everyone points to vote with, and let the draw choose.

faqs.question: Where is warmest in February with a direct flight from Stansted?
faqs.answer: Dubai is the warmest, at about 25°C, followed by Sharm el-Sheikh and Hurghada at about 22 to 23°C. The Canaries are close behind at 20 to 22°C, with a shorter flight and no time difference.

faqs.question: How long is the flight from Stansted to Tenerife?
faqs.answer: About four and a half hours direct. Lanzarote is a little shorter, at about four hours.

faqs.question: When is February half term 2027 near Stansted?
faqs.answer: Essex and Hertfordshire council schools have half term from 15 to 19 February 2027, and most London boroughs use the same week. Academies can set different dates, so check with your school.

faqs.question: Does Jet2 fly from Stansted to Egypt?
faqs.answer: Yes. Jet2 has added Stansted flights to Sharm el-Sheikh and Hurghada for winter 2026/27. Check the days of the week on Jet2's timetable before you book.
